proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: charging the phosphine ligand in place of the palladium precursor removes the intended palladium source and could impair formation of an active catalytic system.
Hypothesis: substituting the aniline for KOtBu leaves the intended strong-base function absent, which could reduce amine activation under the stated coupling conditions.
Hypothesis: reducing the 105 °C hold from the stated 10800 s to the existing 1200 s duration could provide insufficient residence time for the intended transformation.
Hypothesis: deleting the reactor-to-heater connection removes the proposed thermal coupling, so the reactor may not receive the specified heating context.
